seed_derivation: seed(parts) = first 8 bytes big-endian of SHA-256('bcr-20261126/v1|' + '|'.join(parts)); stream = SplitMix64(seed); uniform below m by rejection on 64-bit output
stream_sharing: A1 relation-target stream (8 AP lanes, independent random starts, one common stride) shared by every IC arm; rho records of the frozen run are reused unchanged (same Q, same rho streams)
custody: d is drawn from the 'target' stream inside the evaluator; solvers receive (curve, G, Q, ell) only; correctness compares the recovered d with d_true after the solve and checks [d]G = Q inside the counted solve
rho_lanes_choice: argmin of mean Meq(s=1,u=1) over W in {1,2,4,8,16,32,64}, 2 pilot curves x 16 pilot targets per rung (data/pilot_rho.jsonl), held out from evaluation
primary_metric: Meq(s=1,u=1): field mults + squarings + inversions at Itoh-Tsujii census + 1 per table map / hash probe / mod-ell mult / mod-ell add; whole cold solve from factor base to verified log
band: ratios also at u in {0, 0.1} and s = 0.25 (AGENTS.md 5a); an order between arms is stated only where it holds across the band

analysis.paired_ratio: per case (n, ci, ti): IC arm cost / mean of the 16 rho runs on the same Q
analysis.summary: per rung geometric mean of paired ratios; 95% CI by hierarchical bootstrap (curves, then targets within curve, then rho seeds within target), B = 10000, percentile
analysis.rootfinder_effect: per rung geometric mean of F/G and F/F0 (same cases), same bootstrap
analysis.exponent: OLS slope of log2(case cost) on log2(ell) per arm over all rungs; difference to rho's slope; bootstrap CI resampling cases within rung
analysis.gap: reported as the remaining distance (ratio and CI), never pass/fail

hypotheses.H1: The factored root finder lowers the whole cold IC cost of the m=3 pairs-and-solve arm: F/G < 1 at every rung (expected 0.2-0.35).
hypotheses.H2: It does not move the gap's growth: pairs-and-solve costs Theta(N) for any root finder (counting argument in PROTOCOL.md), so F/rho grows like N^(1/2): slope difference F - rho about +0.5.
hypotheses.H3: The cheapest IC arm on these rungs is a hash (MITM) arm, M2 or M3, and it is still above rho at every rung (ratio CI lower bound > 1).

falsifier: parity is reached at a rung if the upper 95% bound of an IC arm's paired ratio is <= 1 there
exclusions: none; every record, failure, cap hit and mismatch is retained

untested.Koblitz curves (Frobenius rho): for k = 3 (every rung here) a factor-base point of a Koblitz curve has x in F_{2^{n'}} and y in F_{2^{2n'}}, so it lies in E(F_{2^{gcd(2n',3n')}}) = E(F_{2^{n'}}), whose order is below and prime to the large subgroup order ell; the base projects to O and no relation carries information. A Koblitz rung needs a non-subfield base (or k = 2, where the subfield base is the whole twist subgroup) and is out of scope here

stop_rule: stop at the first relation that closes a dependency with sum c*b != 0 (incremental echelon); no rows >= cols+4 rule
